title: Align implementation guide (Ch 41-46)
description: 15-implementation-guide. Kubo RPC is POST-only; pin/remote/add takes arg=; no 'pinner' API; /api/v0/add yields UnixFS CID, use block/put with cid-codec=raw; Kubo keystore not encrypted, no external key mgmt; retry backoff doubling vs 1/4/16/64; '52-char base58' IPNS names. Update to D1-D4.
notes: From esol.4: delete Ch 41 item 6 (Canonical JSON), Ch 43 NFKC/id-less-CID mistakes, Ch 44 verification steps (replace with Ch 34 procedure), Ch 45 canonical-JSON vectors (replace via esol.13 with JWS + Ed25519 strict-profile vectors, e.g. 'Taming the many EdDSAs' edge cases), Ch 46 use block/put --cid-codec=raw.
